The structure of Mn₃Zr crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with a 16-atom unit cell containing four Mn₈Zr₂ composition units and five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies 12-coordinate Mn centers with close-packed-like local arrangements, while Zr centers show 16 geometric neighbors. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner, edge, and face contacts between Mn-centered 12-vertex polyhedra, and corner and edge sharing between Mn and Zr polyhedra.
